title.zh: 多屏拼贴 · 品牌宣传

summary.en: Introduce a brand or creative tool with screen collages, editorial transitions and a branded ending.
summary.zh: 用多屏拼贴、版面切换和品牌收尾展示产品与创作流程，适合品牌介绍和工具宣传。

subtitle.zh: 多屏拼贴 · 品牌宣传

materials.en: Sourceedits: content items, at most 256 items.

materials.zh: Voiceover：文字，不超过 240 个字符。

dependencies.en: The package declares a Python and Node.js host. Check its dependency lock for supported versions and any additional rendering tools.
dependencies.zh: 模板声明使用 Python 和 Node.js。具体工具与版本以下载包为准。

dependencies.en: Use the package dependency lock and setup/check instructions. Check existing tools first, install only missing requirements and verify a preview.
dependencies.zh: 按下载包的依赖锁和 setup/check 说明检查已有工具，只补齐缺项，并验证预览。

en: Adapt the existing product copy, data and brand slots while preserving the complete native animation, composition and timeline.
zh: Adapt the existing product copy, data and brand slots while preserving the complete native animation, composition and timeline.

en: The documented output is 1920 × 1080, 60 fps; default demo duration is 57 seconds.
Use the actual package parameter bounds; extra materials do not automatically create extra scenes.
Changing the scene order or engine; the frozen original source and timeline remain authoritative.
zh: 已声明输出为 1920 × 1080，60 fps；默认样片 57 秒。
按实际包的参数边界制作；增加素材不会自动增加场景。

capabilities.en: Optional services require a live catalog, template slot and account check before they can be confirmed.
capabilities.zh: 配套服务需核对官网实时能力、模板槽位和账号权限后才能确认。
